evaluation.hallucination_trigger: Chinese woodblock or manuscript page with significant damage, ink bleed-through, or faded text. Flash generates thousands of [?] uncertainty markers rather than fabricating characters — a safer but still problematic failure mode.
evaluation.notes: Chinese hallucination pattern is unique: ALL 5 candidates are Flash (not Lite), and the pattern is uncertainty_repetition ([?] markers) rather than generative_fabrication. This suggests Chinese character complexity creates a different failure mode where even thinking-enabled Flash cannot read damaged text, but at least signals uncertainty rather than fabricating.
